description: This Java source file defines the SingleNoteWidgetService class, which extends RemoteViewsService to provide remote views for a widget related to a single note in the Notes app. It creates and returns an instance of SingleNoteWidgetFactory for widget view generation.

classes.name: SingleNoteWidgetService
classes.description: A service extending RemoteViewsService, responsible for providing views for the single note widget.

methods.name: onGetViewFactory
methods.description: Overrides the method to return a widget factory for creating RemoteViews for the widget using the provided Intent.
